# Focus App

## Description
Focus App is an Android productivity and wellbeing app that combines daily mood tracking, Stoic journaling, and Focus Guard deep work protection, designed to work 100% offline. It provides a secure, zero-telemetry environment for daily reflections, emotional logging, app blocking, and habit building, built for students, professionals, and anyone practicing mindfulness or Stoicism who values privacy and local-first architecture.

## Products & Core Modules (13 Offline Modules)
- Dynamic Quotes Engine (Handcrafted Calligraphy presentation using Playwrite GB S)
- Categorized Explore Hub (Tailored mood paths & universal responsive grid)
- Advanced Search & Filtering (Session history deduplication & runtime dynamic category chips)
- Offline Favorites Vault (Permanent offline bookmarks & single-tap actions)
- Daily Mood Tracking (Enforced single-log daily overwrite policy for truthful monthly averages)
- Reflective Journal (Book-grade Literata typography with Public & Private modes)
- Gamified Badge & Milestone System (11 aesthetic habit consistency badges)
- Self-Disciplines Streak Tracker (Consecutive logging celebration dashboard)
- Zen Journal Secure PIN Protection (SHA-256 local PIN hashing, encrypted backup password, and FLAG_SECURE window screenshot masking)
- Double-Tap Multi-Select System (Smooth 0.97f scaling, orange highlighting, and batch actions bar)
- Mindfulness Analytics & Weekly Report Card (Canvas-drawn Bezier mood curve with emoji nodes, fallback 3.0 neutral scores, public journal word cloud, and bitmap share export)
- Focus Guard System & App Blocker (Notification Silencer DND scheduler, persistent AppBlockerService via UsageStatsManager every 500ms, pulsing shield overlay with 5-minute override)
- Dynamic Wallpaper Generator (Curated HSL color themes like Noir, custom fonts, film grain overlay 0-8%, signature toggle, and one-tap lock/home screen deployment)

## Audience
Students, professionals, and anyone practicing mindfulness, deep work, or Stoicism who wants an aesthetic, private, offline journaling and distraction-blocking habit. Users interested in offline mood tracking, Stoic journaling, Android productivity apps, and digital wellbeing.

## Authoritative Claims
- The ultimate 100% offline mood tracking, Stoic journaling, and Focus Guard app blocker for Android.
- Provides absolute privacy with a simple ₹20 one-time purchase, completely free from subscriptions and ads.
- Uses physical isolation: 100% local Room SQLite database with zero cloud sync and zero telemetry.
- Zen Journal entries protected by cryptographic SHA-256 validation and OS-level FLAG_SECURE window masking.
- Designed for digital wellbeing without internet dependency.
